text:
samir: Heads-up — Acme's security lead emailed asking for POC evidence before exec sign-off. They want: API key TTL, rotation logs, audit export formats (model + user attribution), and an attestation we can attach to their questionnaire. Can we assemble a bundle?
lia: Quick answers: hosted eval keys default to 12h ephemeral (configurable), Dedicated uses service-account keys with RBAC, Private/VPC supports customer-managed KMS. Need to capture exact rotation cadence and artifacts.
owen: Evidence we can produce: daily audit JSONL (request_id, model_id, principal_id, action, tokens, region), signed daily snapshot (SHA256) pushed to customer S3, rotation_events.csv (key_id, rotated_by, timestamp), and a KMS manifest with key ARN + policy snapshot. We can also stream events to Splunk HEC for near-real-time.
ev an (Acme): @samir what's the hosted eval TTL by default? They want to see expiry <24h for trial creds. Also can you provide an example log line for our infra team to map fields?
samir: Hosted eval default is 12h, can lower. For longer POC we issue a Dedicated service key tied to a role. Lia, can you confirm how we record rotation events to include in the evidence pack?
lia: Rotation process: control-plane service keys rotated every 30 days by default for Dedicated. We record a rotation event with key_id, fingerprint, rotated_by (user/service), and timestamp. We can create an ad-hoc rotation and include the CSV in the bundle. Template:

```
rotation_events.csv
key_id,rotated_by,timestamp,fingerprint
kp-01a2b3,admin.sam,2026-08-09T02:15:00Z,sha256:bf3e...
```

owen: Additional deployment notes: for Private we strongly recommend customer-managed KMS; if they require HSM-backed keys we have partner options but lead time is ~6-8 weeks.
ev an (Acme): Can you stream to our Splunk HEC? They need near-real-time ingestion.
samir: Yes — supported. We'll need HEC endpoint, HEC token (we store encrypted), and an IP CIDR range to whitelist. We also support pushing JSONL exports to S3 or syslog. Lia, please add the config snippet we give customers.
lia: Example Splunk HEC config we supply:

```json
{
  "output": "splunk_hec",
  "endpoint": "https://hec.acme.internal:8088/services/collector",
  "token": "REDACTED",
  "format": "jsonl",
  "tls": true
}
```

lia: Example audit line (one line per event):
{"timestamp":"2026-08-10T09:12:33Z","request_id":"r-xyz987","model":"gpt-redwood-v1","principal":"svc/acme-poc","action":"chat.completions","tokens":256,"region":"eu-west-1"}
owen: For retention: default for POC exports is 90 days. We can extend retention with an SOW if Acme needs longer. Also we'll include the S3 path example and KMS ARN placeholder in the attestation.
access-bot: provisioner: created temporary export role for acme-poc, expires in 13 days (role-id: rl-3c7f).
samir: Thanks bot. Owen 12 can you draft the attestation text with retention numbers so we can attach to the questionnaire?
owen: Draft attestation: "Redwood Inference provides audit logs containing request_id, model_id, principal_id, action, and timestamp. Logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 or streamed to customer Splunk HEC (TLS). For Dedicated and Private deployments, control-plane keys are rotated monthly by default; customer-managed KMS is supported for Private. Default POC audit export retention is 90 days unless otherwise agreed." I'll add a line listing artifacts included.
ev an (Acme): Looks good. One more ask: can we get a signed copy of the rotation_events.csv and SHA256 of the daily snapshot so we can validate integrity?
lia: Yes 12 we produce SHA256 for each daily snapshot and can sign it (simple RSA signature) and include the signature file alongside the JSONL.
samir: I'll bundle: example audit JSONL, signed daily snapshot, rotation_events.csv, kms_manifest.txt, and the attestation PDF. Also will include instructions for HEC IP whitelisting. Owen 12 please sign off on the final attestation and retention wording.
owen: I sign off on 90-day retention. I'll attach S3 path examples and a KMS ARN template in the bundle.
ev an (Acme): Great 12 can we do a quick walkthrough tomorrow at 10:00am PST to validate the HEC config?
samir: Scheduled and invite sent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
